title: lobularia fruticosa
intro: Lobularia fruticosa, commonly known as sweet alyssum, is a flowering plant species in the mustard family, characterized by its small, white, and fragrant flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Lobularia fruticosa include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
